question:
A publishing house publishes two types of books: fiction (F) and non-fiction (N). Each F takes 3 hours editing, 1 hour typesetting. Each N takes 2 hours editing, 2 hours typesetting. There are 24 hours available for editing and 12 for typesetting per week. The house wants to publish at least 2 F and 3 N per week. Profit on F is ₹40, on N is ₹60.

(a) Write the LPP.

(b) Identify all corner points of the feasible region.

(c) Find the optimal weekly publication plan.

options.A:
(a) Maximize $Z=40x+60y$, subject to $3x+2y\leq24$, $x+2y\leq12$, $x\geq2$, $y\geq3$
(b) Feasible corner points: $(2,3)$, $(2,5)$, $(6,3)$
(c) Publish 6 fiction and 3 non-fiction; maximum profit ₹420.
options.B:
(a) Maximize $Z=40x+60y$, subject to $3x+2y\leq24$, $x+2y\leq12$, $x\geq2$, $y\geq3$

(c) Publish 2 fiction and 5 non-fiction; maximum profit ₹380.
